description: In a move to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence across governance and public services, the Bihar Government has entered into strategic partnerships with Google, Microsoft, CoRover, and Sarvam AI.
body_lead: Patna: In a move to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence across governance and public services, the Bihar Government has entered into strategic partnerships with Google, Microsoft, CoRover, and Sarvam AI. The agreements are aimed at strengthening the State’s AI ecosystem through capacity building, research, innovation, and digital transformation. The Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs), approved by the State Cabinet, are focused on promoting the use of AI across key sectors without involving any financial commitment from the government.
